result.title: Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies
result.summary: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无监督偏好对齐框架 PGPG，用「有序覆盖对齐」度量自主采集的 rollout 相对少量专家示范的序列进度，自动生成伪偏好标签，从而在无人工标注与手工奖励下微调扩散、flow-matching 等生成式控制策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以进度估计自动构造偏好监督、免人工标注」的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供自动监督线索，可供核查；但任务域为机器人操作控制，与视觉或多模态推理状态的关联尚未验证。
